name: Games draw with the carnival theme
instruction: Game drawing code uses the shared carnival theme and canvasFont helper instead of hard-coded canvas colours or font strings.
relevant_when: A TypeScript file under src/games/<game-id>/game.ts that contains canvas drawing code, such as assignments to CanvasRenderingContext2D fillStyle, strokeStyle, font, lineWidth, textAlign, or drawing calls.
context: AGENTS.md says every game draws with the carnival theme: colours, fonts and sizes come from theme and canvasFont in src/carnival/theme.ts, with no hex colours or font strings inside a game. This keeps booths visually consistent.
scope_reason: A game.ts file contains the drawing code and imports needed to decide whether it uses shared theme values or hard-coded presentation values.

checklist.name: uses-theme-colours
checklist.rule: Canvas colour assignments in the game use values from theme.colors, or a clearly delegated shared carnival constant, rather than hard-coded colour literals such as hex, rgb, hsl, or named CSS colours. Return not applicable if the file has no canvas colour assignments.

checklist.name: uses-canvas-font-helper
checklist.rule: Canvas font assignments in the game use canvasFont from src/carnival/theme.ts rather than a hand-written font string. Return not applicable if the file has no canvas font assignments.
